text:
Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters, clams, and mussels.

To enrich the artistic concept of the urban life exhibition, the hip-hop playlist can be adapted to mirror the formation of these pearls. Just as a pearl is created when an irritant enters a mollusk and is slowly coated in layers of nacre, the gritty atmosphere of city living can be viewed as the initial irritant. The relentless pace and urban noise serve as the rough core, while the rhythmic beats and lyrical flow of the hip-hop tracks act as the smooth, protective layers of nacre. This transformation turns the harshness of the city into something valuable and resonant, much like the beauty of a pearl emerging from an irritant. The music thus becomes the artistic medium that encases the raw energy of urban existence, creating a harmonious and polished experience for the viewer.
